name: Seas of Conflict
desc:
Face off against the greatest naval powers in the world! Can you change the tides of war? In this game, the United States and Chinese militaries battle for supremacy over the South China Sea.

Join the group to receive a free Uzi for your loadout!

Check out the bulletin board post for updates and private server commands.
